    Controls

    How to play

    Choose your landing

    Check the bus route and next safe zone on the island map. Leave the bus and glide to a town or a quieter outpost.

    Get geared up

    Look at loot to compare it with your current gear. Search chests for better equipment and use your pickaxe to collect building materials.

    Stay ahead of the storm

    Watch the storm countdown and move toward the next ring. Use walls for cover and ramps for a better angle.
